second_pass_findings.corridor_desc: STILL UNRESOLVED after a dedicated retry -- could not produce two distinct, independently-geocoded coordinates, so no lon/lat is asserted for either endpoint (never fabricating a coordinate). What's missing, precisely: WDGC is now confirmed to sit in a specifically-named sub-area ('Industrial Nahda Zone', 33 acres, per the Train D golden-license coverage) but that zone name has zero footprint in GeoNames/OSM/Nominatim/Photon -- there is nothing to geocode it against. The butane plant has no comparable zone/address lead at all despite a full re-check of every EOG article that mentions it (3 articles + the tag archive), and the prior pass's 'Merghem' claim for it does not hold up against its own cited sources. A targeted Overpass search of the entire Amreya/El-Dekheila/Merghem industrial belt (multiple bounding boxes, ~6-8km radius each) for any feature named GASCO, Western Desert, Amreya + butane/LPG, or Nahda returned zero results -- these facilities are simply not present in OSM by name, so no free public map/gazetteer can separate them. GASCO's own site (which likely has the clearest facility info) is unusable as a citable source: it fails TLS certificate verification. This is now a well-defined, narrower target for a human/GIS pass (satellite imagery search within the ~33-acre Industrial Nahda Zone specifically, rather than 'somewhere in greater Amreya') but genuinely cannot be resolved further via WebFetch/public-gazetteer research. RouteAccuracy should stay 'low'.
